title: MIDDLE MOUSE: PING AND SIGNAL
why: His order of 2026-10-13: middle mouse is the ping / mark, so you can mark while aiming; V keeps working. The middle button already pinged for the party through a line of its own, which was not on the key list and could not be changed, and alone it did nothing. It is a key now, like the two side buttons: the action sits on the rebind list (Settings, CHANGE KEYS, PARTY) as MIDDLE MOUSE, default the middle button, and can be moved to any key or button. In a party a press marks the spot or the enemy under the cursor for your teammates, as N does (on the open map it is your map marker); alone it opens and closes the V signal strip, so hail and stand down are one click from the aim. The press is claimed in a raid so the browser autoscroll never starts, and the controls list names the button beside N.
now: Middle mouse pings for the party and, alone, opens the V signal strip; it is on the rebind list.
